Explanation
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1) First, we lock SALES_DB.CUSTOMER in TD_MAP1 for read on a reserved
     RowHash to prevent global deadlock.
  2) Next, we lock SALES_DB.SALES_TXN in TD_MAP1 for read on a reserved
     RowHash in all partitions to prevent global deadlock.
  3) We lock SALES_DB.CUSTOMER in TD_MAP1 for read, and we lock
     SALES_DB.SALES_TXN in TD_MAP1 for read.
  4) We do an all-AMPs RETRIEVE step in TD_MAP1 from SALES_DB.CUSTOMER by
     way of an all-rows scan with no residual conditions into Spool 2
     (all_amps), which is duplicated on all AMPs in TD_Map1.  The size
     of Spool 2 is estimated with no confidence to be 24,000,000 rows (
     720,000,000 bytes).  The estimated time for this step is 3.20
     seconds.
  5) We do an all-AMPs JOIN step in TD_Map1 from Spool 2 (Last Use) by
     way of an all-rows scan, which is joined to SALES_DB.SALES_TXN by
     way of an all-rows scan with a condition of ("(CAST((SALES_DB.SALES_TXN.SALE_DT) AS CHAR(7)))= '2024-01'").
     Spool 2 and SALES_DB.SALES_TXN are joined using a product join,
     with a join condition of ("(SALES_DB.SALES_TXN.CUST_ID = CUST_ID) OR (SALES_DB.SALES_TXN.PROD_ID = CUST_ID)").
     The result goes into Spool 1 (group_amps), which is built locally on
     the AMPs.  The size of Spool 1 is estimated with no confidence to
     be 98,000,000 rows (5,880,000,000 bytes).  The estimated time for
     this step is 1 hour and 12 minutes.
  6) Finally, we send out an END TRANSACTION step to all AMPs involved
     in processing the request.
  -> The contents of Spool 1 are sent back to the user as the result of
     statement 1.  The total estimated time is 1 hour and 12 minutes.
     BEGIN RECOMMENDED STATS FOR FINAL PLAN->
     -- "COLLECT STATISTICS COLUMN (CUST_ID) ON SALES_DB.CUSTOMER"
     (High Confidence)
     -- "COLLECT STATISTICS COLUMN (SALE_DT) ON SALES_DB.SALES_TXN"
     (High Confidence)
     -- "COLLECT STATISTICS COLUMN (PARTITION) ON SALES_DB.SALES_TXN"
     (High Confidence)
     <- END RECOMMENDED STATS FOR FINAL PLAN
